Container.Name: kb-webui
Container.Overview: Open WebUI - the chat window over the shared knowledge library. STARTED IN ORDER: kb-postgres first, then kb-service, then kb-webui. There is no template equivalent of compose depends_on, so nothing enforces that for you. NETWORK: the kb containers share one user-defined Docker network named kb that you create once, by hand, before the first start (a template cannot create a network, so Network stays bridge here - set it to kb when you create the container). Docker must preserve user-defined networks across updates (Unraid: Settings > Docker, Preserve user defined networks = Yes), or the containers fall back to bridge and the container names stop resolving. EXPOSURE: this container is exposed on your LAN through the host port you choose; unlike kb-postgres it is meant to be reached from the wider network. Anything further (a domain, reverse proxy, TLS) is a separate step for whoever administers your network. COOKIES: the UI is served over plain HTTP, so the secure-cookie setting ships off; turn WEBUI_SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE on when a TLS front end exists, or login breaks the other way round. ACCOUNTS: authentication is on and sign-up is off; the first administrator is created on the first visit to an empty database, after which registration stays closed. MFA: multi-factor sign-in is on by default, so every user also needs an authenticator app. A user who loses both the authenticator and the recovery codes needs the operator to run open-webui mfa reset --email EMAIL --reason TEXT inside this container. SCOPE: these settings limit access through the application only; whoever has host or database access is inside the trust boundary, and encryption at rest is not configured. STORAGE: the data mount holds the chat database and uploaded files - put it under backup. The update check and the analytics switches are off. IMAGE TAG: pinned to one release; an Update is a deliberate bump of that pin.
Container.Description: Open WebUI chat window over the knowledge library. Start this last. LAN-exposed; set a free host port and a secret key.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host port for the web UI; the container always listens on 8080 internally - change the host side only. No default is offered because 8080 is taken on the usual host: pick a free port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Chat database, uploaded files and model caches. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kb-webui/data. Put it under backup.

Config.Name: WEBUI_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Signing key for login sessions; the app refuses to start with authentication on and no key. Use a long random value and keep it stable - changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: WEBUI_AUTH
Config.Description: Require login. Leave true.

Config.Name: ENABLE_SIGNUP
Config.Description: Allow self-registration. false: only the first administrator, created on an empty database, and accounts an administrator adds.

Config.Name: WEBUI_SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Mark the login cookies Secure. false while the UI is served over plain HTTP (a Secure cookie is never sent over HTTP and login fails). Set true when a TLS front end exists.

Config.Name: WEBUI_SESSION_COOKIE_SAME_SITE
Config.Description: SameSite attribute of the login cookies: lax, strict or none. Leave lax. none is refused by browsers unless WEBUI_SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE is true.

Config.Name: ENABLE_MFA
Config.Description: Require a second sign-in factor (an authenticator app) from every user. Leave true.

Config.Name: MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Fernet key (44 URL-safe base64 characters) that encrypts the stored MFA secrets. Blank: derived from WEBUI_SECRET_KEY. Set once; changing it later makes existing authenticators unusable.

Config.Name: JWT_EXPIRES_IN
Config.Description: How long a login lasts, as a duration such as 12h, 7d or 4w. Must not be blank: a blank value stops sign-in. -1 never expires and is not recommended.

Config.Name: CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN
Config.Description: Browser origins allowed to call the API, semicolon-separated, each as <scheme>://<host>:<port>. Leave * (any origin; the app logs a warning). Must not be blank: a blank value stops the app from starting.

Config.Name: FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS
Config.Description: Address of the reverse proxy whose forwarded client headers the app trusts, format <proxy-ip>. Blank: every sender is trusted, which is the app's own default. Set it once a proxy is in front of this container.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Ollama endpoint, format http://<host>:<port> . Blank: the app falls back to its own built-in address, which reaches nothing useful from this container.

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_BASE_URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, format http://<host>:<port>/v1 . Blank: the app falls back to the public OpenAI address, which without a key does nothing.

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Key for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint above. Blank if the endpoint takes none.

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Redis connection shared by instances, format redis://<user>:<password>@<host>:<port>/<db>. Blank: no Redis.

Config.Name: WEBSOCKET_MANAGER
Config.Description: Socket manager. redis when Redis is used (needs REDIS_URL); blank for a single instance.

Config.Name: HSTS
Config.Description: Strict-Transport-Security header, format max-age=<seconds>. Blank: not sent. Browsers ignore it over plain HTTP.

Config.Name: XFRAME_OPTIONS
Config.Description: X-Frame-Options header: DENY or SAMEORIGIN. Blank: not sent.

Config.Name: XCONTENT_TYPE
Config.Description: Set to nosniff to send the X-Content-Type-Options header. Blank: not sent.

Config.Name: REFERRER_POLICY
Config.Description: Referrer-Policy header, for example strict-origin-when-cross-origin. Blank: not sent.

Config.Name: PERMISSIONS_POLICY
Config.Description: Permissions-Policy header, a comma-separated list such as camera=(), microphone=(). Blank: not sent.

Config.Name: CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY
Config.Description: Content-Security-Policy header, a semicolon-separated directive list. Blank: not sent. An enforced policy can break the UI; try the report-only variable first.

Config.Name: CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY_REPORT_ONLY
Config.Description: Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only header, same format. Blank: not sent. Violations are reported to the browser, not blocked.

Config.Name: ENABLE_ADMIN_EXPORT
Config.Description: Allow the administrator export feature. Upstream default is true.

Config.Name: ENABLE_ADMIN_CHAT_ACCESS
Config.Description: Let administrators read other users' chats. Blank: off, so chats stay private to each user. Set true only where the operator must see chats.

Config.Name: ENABLE_ADMIN_WORKSPACE_CONTENT_ACCESS
Config.Description: Let administrators read workspace content owned by other users. Blank: off.

Config.Name: ENABLE_COMMUNITY_SHARING
Config.Description: Allow users to publish content to the upstream community sharing feature. Blank: off.

Config.Name: ENABLE_FORWARD_USER_INFO_HEADERS
Config.Description: Forward the signed-in user's identity headers to the model endpoints. Blank: off, so they are not sent.

Config.Name: ENABLE_VERSION_UPDATE_CHECK
Config.Description: Ask the upstream project whether a newer version exists. false: no outbound check.

Config.Name: SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS
Config.Description: Opt out of Scarf package analytics. Leave true.

Config.Name: DO_NOT_TRACK
Config.Description: Standard do-not-track switch read by bundled libraries. Leave true.

Config.Name: ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY
Config.Description: Anonymized usage telemetry of the bundled vector-store library. Leave false.
